{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABapQSJw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhEP4sY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 79, "title": "Correct VDP2 mosaic sampling across interlace and rotation modes", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At `e5a3ce0650efe1ede1072f36136d13116e43cf94`, `Vdp2::normal_sample` computes vertical mosaic size as `MZSZV + 1` and quantizes the incoming Y coordinate without considering interlace. Double-density acquisition supplies `line * 2 + field parity`. Consequently, enabling minimum-size mosaic leaves that field-dependent source sampling unchanged. The rotation path quantizes X but likewise retains the incoming double-density Y behavior.

This misses documented behavior of standard VDP2 mosaic effects. Existing tests establish horizontal grouping and vertical-cell-scroll exclusion, but do not establish interlaced mosaic semantics or complete layer coverage. Incorrect sampling can change guest graphics without producing a diagnostic.

## Expected outcome

Implement the documented MZCTL behavior through the existing VDP2 acquisition and composition paths, covering NBG0–NBG3 and RBG0/RBG1 where applicable.

The hardware contract comes from [VDP2 ST-058-R2 §4.11, printed pp.117–119, Figure 4.19 and MZCTL](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-058-R2-060194.pdf), reconciled with the [later Sega §4.11 specification](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp2/hon/p04_b0.htm). It specifies upper-left-dot mosaic sampling, horizontal sizes 1–16, vertical sizes 1–16 in noninterlace and 2–32 in interlace, single-density display when mosaic is enabled in double-density mode, horizontal-only processing for rotation screens, and vertical-cell-scroll exclusion on affected NBG0/NBG1 screens. [§2.2](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp2/hon/p02_20.htm) distinguishes single-density and double-density pictures.

Document the relationship between output rows, field lines and source coordinates before implementing it. Include the density interaction in rotation sampling and retained parameter use. Preserve hardware mode state and the independent behavior of unaffected screens. Resolve any mistaken task assumptions through affirmative primary references and documented rationale; no human-confirmation gate is required.

## Context and reproduction

Code inspection identifies the missing behavior:

- `src/vdp2.rs:195–208` and `src/vdp2/fetch.rs:196–208` derive double-density rows globally.
- `src/vdp2.rs:665–669` applies mode-independent mosaic grouping.
- `src/vdp2/rotation.rs:371–412` applies horizontal mosaic while retaining Y for coefficients and transformed coordinates.
- `tests/video.rs:392–407` tests horizontal mosaic; `tests/video_effects.rs:104–125` tests cell-scroll exclusion.
- `docs/hardware-conformance.md:629` explicitly lacks vertical/layer/guest evidence and incorrectly cites mosaic under §5 rather than §4.11.

Create a regression using distinct adjacent source rows, double-density display and minimum-size mosaic. Observe both fields and compare the affected screen with independently specified single-density sampling. Include additional source rows so merely duplicating adjacent output rows cannot satisfy the oracle accidentally.

The focused scope is mosaic coordinate selection, its necessary acquisition/parameter integration, and independent validation. Half-line raster timing, unrelated window/color-calculation corrections and general video refactoring remain separate work.

The supplied main CI snapshot has native and Wasm jobs in progress. Those observations establish neither failure nor success. The latest validation record reports passing suites, but does not cover this missing mosaic contract.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record a primary-derived mosaic coordinate table covering noninterlace, single-density and double-density modes, selected versus unaffected screens, and normal versus rotation backgrounds. Reconcile later specifications and applicable corrections; distinguish unspecified sampling phases from hardware requirements.
- [ ] Implement the contract in actual scheduled display acquisition and snapshot decoding. Cover NBG0–NBG3, applicable bitmap/tile paths, RBG0 parameter A/B and RBG1. Preserve horizontal-only rotation processing, NBG0/NBG1 cell-scroll exclusion, legal VRAM grants, retained operands and one-shot RPRCTL behavior.
- [ ] Add independent native pixel/address vectors covering all sixteen size encodings on each axis, block boundaries, both field parities, enabled/disabled layers, scroll offsets and representative zoom settings. Include mixed mosaic/non-mosaic composition and rotation cases that distinguish source-row selection from output-row duplication. Author expected values independently of production helpers.
- [ ] Add original MIT-licensed SH-2 guest media that writes its own source patterns and VDP2 registers, selects mosaic controls and publishes guest-computed progress records. Execute identical bytes in native Machine and production browser Wasm. Assert literal framebuffer and Canvas pixels across both fields, including normal-screen and rotation cases. Supply source, reproducible builder and hashes, registered in the existing fixture/browser workflow.
- [ ] Include changed-source, changed-size and omitted-enable controls, plus repeated cold boots. Demonstrate that a focused field-density oracle fails on the inherited implementation or a mutation restoring its mapping, then passes after correction. Hosts must not inject running guest results or pixels.
- [ ] Verify scheduled results are invariant across advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000 and passive inspection. Test reset and legal field-boundary control updates for stale retained samples. Preserve existing display dimensions, unaffected field behavior, sprite composition and valid regression assertions; document any evidence-backed correction to an older expectation.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, `sh scripts/check-fixtures.sh`, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, `node --test scripts/ci-runner.test.mjs`, and the complete `npm run test:browser` aggregate without skipping required scenarios. Preserve Star Collector, Prism Courier and Hardware Lab.
- [ ] Update architecture, conformance and validation records with exact specification/implementation/test links and actual results. Correct the mosaic citation and separate historical subset claims from current evidence. Report remaining #17 CPU/peripheral, multiprocessor/bus/reset/DMA/interrupt, SCU/DSP, video/audio/CD timing, BIOS/HLE/SMPC and integrated acceptance scope. Do not claim umbrella completion or demonstrated commercial compatibility from this increment.

## Optional validation

Additional lawful compatibility observations may supplement the original fixtures; none are required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
